scenarios.label: Pick or pass
scenarios.description: Seat 4 holds JH, 8C, 9D, 8H, 10D, 8D and must PICK or PASS. (This seat goes on to pick.)

scenarios.label: Call a partner
scenarios.description: Seat 4 picked and now holds JH, 8C, 9D, 8H, 10D, 8D, 7H, 8S (8 cards after the blind). It must choose a partner card — the two-tower CALL scorer is the live head here.

scenarios.label: Bury two cards
scenarios.description: Seat 4 (the picker) holds JH, 8C, 9D, 8H, 10D, 8D, 7H, 8S and must bury its first card — the pointer head scores every hand slot.

scenarios.label: Lead trick 1
scenarios.description: Seat 1 (a defender) leads trick 1 with QD, JD, 9H, AS, 7C, JS. The trick is empty; memory now carries the pick phase.

scenarios.label: Follow late in the hand
scenarios.description: Trick 4: seat 1 (a defender) follows with QD, JD, JS after several cards hit the table. Trick tokens are live and the memory token carries every completed trick.
